dev_allowed: threshold methodology derivation only if explicitly permitted; numeric engineering threshold not fabricated
eval_forbidden_before_freeze_and_open: add/remove candidate algorithms using EVAL and report as held-out
dev_eval_firewall.post_eval_failure: If EVAL reveals failure and a new method is developed, that is a new experimental generation/version; old EVAL becomes DEV/observed for the new generation and a new held-out EVAL is required for fresh confirmatory claims.

b_selected_rule.definition: B_selected(M) is the preregistered causal baseline family+frozen hyperparameters with lowest DEV miss-bytes-per-decode-step score at primary budget M under the deterministic condition, computed over the preregistered R2-09A DEV tournament corpus with equal weight per DEV workload instance. Selected/frozen before EVAL inspection/opening.
b_selected_rule.dev_corpus: R2-09A must freeze its exact DEV tournament trace/instance set in the R2-09A manifest before any tuning/selection. The corpus may include canonical DEV traces from R2-01/R2-03 coding and/or R2-08 DEV workload captures; inclusion is frozen prospectively, not chosen by results.

aggregation.normalization_denominator: decode_steps(i): number of decode routing steps/events in instance i under the frozen replay/trace semantics (deterministic count from trace). Prevents raw unequal-length trace totals from silently dominating selection.
aggregation.weights: equal weight 1/N per DEV workload instance (after normalization)
tie_breaking: stable lexical family_id + canonical config id
aggregation.rationale: DEV traces/instances may differ in length (e.g., R2-01 coding trace and R2-08 matched-horizon DEV captures). Normalized miss bytes per decode step with equal instance weight avoids unintended longer-trace dominance while remaining deterministic and workload-balanced.

b_selected_rule.family_conditioned_secondary: B_selected(M,W_inst_or_category) may be reported as secondary diagnostic only if the conditioning variable is observable before retention decisions and the conditioning rule is preregistered/frozen before DEV tuning; not required for primary claims.
b_selected_rule.b_oracle_family_on_eval: hindsight best among preregistered causal baselines on EVAL; diagnostic only; NEVER deployable selected baseline; NEVER used as primary predictor comparison.
b_selected_rule.primary_predictor_comparison: DEV-selected B_selected(M) (and preregistered continuity baselines) only.

falsification.aggregate_rule: Primary confirmatory claims require preregistered per-cell reporting. Any aggregate claim must report all primary (M, held-out workload instance, deterministic) cells; an aggregate improvement must not hide systematic losses on any held-out workload instance/category nominal cell. Exact aggregate pass rule for R2-11 confirmatory retention claim: no systematic loss on any primary held-out workload instance at a budget where comparison is valid, and aggregate DEV-selected scientific improvement direction holds on the primary deterministic set, subject to frozen cell definitions. Confirmatory claims are limited to the four frozen held-out instances; family/category-level generalization is unmeasured. Engineering materiality remains NOT_EVALUABLE_PENDING_CALIBRATION unless policy-stream performance calibration is frozen and passed.

primary_confirmatory: B_selected(M) vs P on miss bytes per primary (M, held-out workload instance, deterministic)
primary prediction metric future_requested_expert_recall_at_k (fixed k_tl, exact output cardinality) on next-step same-layer target
exploratory: any non-preregistered model/horizon/metric/threshold added after observing EVAL; must be labeled exploratory and cannot rescue failed primary hypothesis

reporting_granularity.confirmatory_scope: limited to four frozen held-out workload instances (one per nominal category); family/category-level generalization unmeasured
required_fields_per_cell: nominal workload category (metadata only; not family-level generalization claim)
decode_steps and/or normalized miss_bytes_per_decode_step where applicable
primary predictive metric (recall at k_tl, k_tl recorded)
engineering relevance metric only if scientifically valid

spec_visibility.rationale: Exact EVAL workload spec/prompt files are stored in the tracked repository for immutable provenance and SHA binding. In a repository-accessible workflow this does not prevent reading prompt content before method freeze; therefore the benchmark is not claimed as fully blinded to EVAL task content.
controls: EVAL performance/results remain locked and must not be inspected until B_selected and selected R2-10 predictor/config are frozen and EVAL opening is recorded.
Prompt-specific feature/model engineering tailored to exact EVAL prompt/task content is prohibited.
No EVAL result may be used for tuning/selection/metric/threshold/falsification changes or candidate addition/removal while reporting held-out EVAL.
Violation or prompt-content-driven overfitting risk must be reported as a benchmark-integrity limitation.
